subsystems.name: Engineered skin cells
subsystems.role: keratinocytes and fibroblasts that carry the light-producing genes and renew themselves.
parts: skin stem cells with edited genome

subsystems.name: Luminescence cassette
subsystems.role: the DNA that makes the light chemistry.
parts: substrate-recycling enzymes (bacterial lux pathway) or a plant/fungal pathway
fluorescent protein for colour (needs separate excitation light)

subsystems.name: Fuel and cofactor supply
subsystems.role: bioluminescence burns ATP and oxygen, so the tissue must supply both continuously.
parts: substrate (luciferin or coelenterazine) or an enzyme set that makes its own

subsystems.name: Gene delivery and control
subsystems.role: puts the cassette into skin stem cells and lets the glow be switched on and off.
parts: viral or non-viral vector, or CRISPR knock-in at a safe locus

subsystems.name: Optical layer
subsystems.role: skin scatters light heavily, so the emitting layer must be near the surface and shaped to direct light out.

subsystems.name: Immune interface
subsystems.role: foreign enzymes provoke an immune attack unless the tissue is made hypoimmunogenic or tolerated.

buildSteps.title: Choose the light chemistry
buildSteps.detail: Decide between a substrate-fed system such as firefly luciferase, which needs a supply of luciferin, and a self-sufficient pathway such as the bacterial lux operon or the fungal pathway engineered into plants, which recycles its own substrate.

buildSteps.title: Engineer the gene cassette
buildSteps.detail: Codon-optimise the genes for human cells and place them under a promoter that is either always on or triggered by a small molecule or a natural signal such as adrenaline.

buildSteps.title: Test in cultured skin
buildSteps.detail: Introduce the cassette into skin stem cells with a lentiviral vector or targeted CRISPR knock-in, then grow them into sheets and measure brightness, colour and toxicity.

buildSteps.title: Build a graft
buildSteps.detail: Seed the cells onto a dermal scaffold, let them stratify into a proper epidermis, and confirm the light still escapes through the outer layers.

buildSteps.title: Supply the fuel
buildSteps.detail: Deliver substrate topically or systemically, or rely on a self-contained pathway; check that the extra ATP and oxygen demand does not starve or overheat the tissue.

buildSteps.title: Manage immunity
buildSteps.detail: Use hypoimmunogenic cells or local immune suppression, because luciferase and the other enzymes are foreign proteins and will otherwise be rejected.

buildSteps.title: Add control and safety
buildSteps.detail: Fit an inducible off-switch, verify the edited cells are not cancerous, and confirm the changes stay in the skin and never reach eggs or sperm.

buildSteps.title: Test in humans
buildSteps.detail: Start with a medical use such as tracking a graft, then only later consider cosmetic applications.

prerequisites.tech: Somatic gene therapy and cell engineering
prerequisites.why: approved therapies exist for blood and some tissues, but stable, widespread expression in skin is not routine.
bacterial and fungal pathways have been engineered into microbes and plants, not into human tissue.
cultured skin substitutes are already used clinically for burns and ulcers.

prerequisites.tech: Safe editing of skin stem cells
prerequisites.why: the stem cells that renew skin must be edited for a permanent effect, and long-term safety is unproven.
without it, the glowing tissue would be destroyed by the body's own defences.

prerequisites.tech: Molecular sensing of mood or environment
prerequisites.why: coupling a hormone or nerve signal to gene expression inside skin has never been demonstrated.

pathway.milestone: glowing plants and microbes used in research and novelty products, alongside clinical skin grafts
pathway.unlocks: working light chemistry and a way to grow human skin in the lab.

pathway.milestone: bioluminescent human skin cells and animal grafts used as medical imaging tools
pathway.unlocks: proof that edited skin survives, stays bright and causes no tumours.

pathway.milestone: first human trials for a medical indication, switched on only on demand
pathway.unlocks: safety and immune data in people.

pathway.milestone: cosmetic dermal layers with colour or glow
pathway.unlocks: a genuinely new body-modification technology, if the immune and consent problems are solved.
